metadata.title: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli for direct production of 1,4-butanediol
metadata.engineering_level: de novo heterologous pathway construction + host optimization

reference.title: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli for direct production of 1,4-butanediol

trigger.observation: E. coli 没有 1,4-丁二醇(1,4-BDO)的天然合成途径。这是一个 de novo(从头)通路构建问题,而非对已有通路的改造。
trigger.reasoning: 非天然产物必须先解决'通路从哪来'的问题:需要用 RetroPath/novoStoic 等工具枚举可能的合成路线,然后选择在热力学和酶学上最可行的路线。

evidence.description: 1,4-BDO 不在 E. coli 天然代谢网络中——这是 EcoCyc/KEGG 可确认的事实。
evidence.source_location: KEGG: no native 1,4-butanediol pathway in E. coli

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 代谢网络中的通路存在/不存在是已策展的数据库事实,属硬证据。

alternatives.approach: 尝试改造 E. coli 的天然二醇途径来产 1,4-BDO
alternatives.rejected_reason: E. coli 没有 C4 二醇的天然骨架,改造成本可能高于从头构建

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 策划并插入完整的异源 1,4-BDO 合成途径(多基因)

result.after: 获得功能性 1,4-BDO 合成能力

decision_chain.rule: 宿主缺乏目标产物的天然途径时,优先从头构建(de novo pathway construction)而非尝试改造不存在的路线。通路选择需经 RetroPath/novoStoic 等枚举+热力学筛选,不凭直觉选。

target.pathway: 中心碳代谢 → 前体和辅因子供应 → 异源 1,4-BDO 途径

trigger.observation: 异源途径插入后,1,4-BDO 产量远低于理论预期。异源途径的酶已表达,但通量仍然很低——提示宿主的前体/辅因子供应与该途径不匹配。
trigger.reasoning: 构建 de novo 途径时,最容易忽视的是宿主的代谢网络是否能为新途径提供足够的前体(pyruvate, α-ketoglutarate 等)和辅因子(NADH, NADPH)。这不是'通路建好就自动跑'的问题——异源途径和宿主代谢的接口往往是真正的瓶颈。
trigger.source_location: Results: initial titers after pathway insertion

evidence.description: 初始插入异源途径后的低产量(论文实测)。具体的前体/辅因子限制需要 metabolomics 或 FBA 分析确认。
evidence.source_location: Results: BDO titer after initial pathway construction

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 低产量是实测结果。具体哪些前体/辅因子限制需要进一步实验确认,但'存在限制'这一结论是硬的。

alternatives.approach: 只增加异源酶的拷贝数
alternatives.rejected_reason: 如果限制在前体/辅因子层面,增加酶表达只是增加闲置容量

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 宿主优化:增强前体合成途径,调优辅因子再生系统(如 pntAB 过表达改变 NADH/NADPH 平衡)

result.before: 仅途径插入(宿主未优化)
result.after: 途径插入 + 宿主前体/辅因子优化后产量提升

decision_chain.rule: de novo 途径工程必须配对宿主层面优化(前体+辅因子供给),不能当作独立的基因插入任务。途径和宿主的接口(interface)往往才是真正的瓶颈——检查前体池、辅因子比和能量状态。

target.gene: ldh, adh, pfl, pta, frd (候选敲除列表)
target.enzyme: lactate dehydrogenase, alcohol dehydrogenase, pyruvate formate lyase, phosphotransacetylase, fumarate reductase
target.pathway: 中心碳代谢—发酵副产物途径

trigger.observation: E. coli 在厌氧/微氧条件下通过混合酸发酵消耗大量碳通量:ldh(乳酸)、adh(乙醇)、pfl-pta-ackA(乙酸)、frd(琥珀酸)。这些副产物途径与异源 1,4-BDO 途径竞争同一前体池(pyruvate, acetyl-CoA, NADH)。
trigger.reasoning: 1,4-BDO 途径是还原性途径(消耗 NADH),而 E. coli 的混合酸发酵也是还原性途径。两者竞争 NADH 和碳骨架。要集中碳流 → 必须敲除竞争性的发酵副产物途径。
trigger.source_location: Known E. coli mixed-acid fermentation pathways (EcoCyc) + OptKnock predictions

evidence.description: 1) 化学计量:ldh/adh/pfl/pta/frd 各消耗来自 pyruvate 的碳通量——这是已知代谢网络事实(硬)。2) OptKnock 等工具可预测敲除这些基因后的生长偶联效果(软证据,需实测)。3) 论文实测了部分敲除的产量提升。
evidence.source: EcoCyc + OptKnock 预测 + 论文实测
evidence.source_location: EcoCyc: fermentation pathways; OptKnock: knockout predictions; Results: knockout effects on titer

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 副产物途径的化学计量是硬证据(已知代谢网络);敲除效果中的化学计量部分(碳不再流入副产物)是硬推理;但生长偶联预测(OptKnock)为软证据。综合:基因必需性反查(硬)+ 敲除效果方向(硬)+ 定量预测(软)。

alternatives.approach: 不敲除、仅通过过程控制(pH/溶氧)抑制副产物
alternatives.rejected_reason: 过程调控无法完全消除副产物,且增加了过程复杂度
部分基因(如 ackA)对生长有影响,需要逐个验证;不是所有副产物途径都能同时敲

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 依次敲除 ldhA, adhE, pflB, pta, frdA/B/C——优先敲对生长影响小的,每一步验证产量和生长

result.before: 碳通量分散到多个发酵副产物
result.after: 碳通量集中在 1,4-BDO(通过减少副产物竞争实现)

decision_chain.rule: 通量集中:敲发酵副产物途径(ldh/adh/pfl/pta/frd)。还原态产物(需要 NADH 的)再额外敲还原支(mdh)并解阻遏(arcA)。每条敲除前后验证生长——用 COBRApy 基因必需性反查防止敲必需基因。组合敲除效果先 FBA 模拟再实测,OptKnock 的预测标为软证据。

engineering_actions.gene_or_pathway: multi-gene heterologous pathway; specific gene identities are not specified in the problem summary available to this V1 knowledge base and require review of the primary text
engineering_actions.source: Yim H. et al., 2011, Nature Chemical Biology, DOI:10.1038/nchembio.580
engineering_actions.rationale: since the host lacks a native pathway to the product, constructing and inserting a synthetic/heterologous pathway is the primary engineering action rather than modifying an existing pathway.
engineering_actions.expected_effect: establishes baseline biosynthetic capability for 1,4-BDO in the host
engineering_actions.risk: heterologous enzymes may have suboptimal kinetics or expression in E. coli; a multi-step pathway adds metabolic burden that can reduce growth
validation: confirm 1,4-BDO production analytically (e.g. HPLC or GC-MS)
assess strain growth and viability with the pathway expressed

engineering_actions.target: precursor and cofactor supply for the heterologous pathway
engineering_actions.gene_or_pathway: host central metabolism and cofactor-regeneration systems; specific gene identities are not specified in the problem summary available to this V1 knowledge base
engineering_actions.source: Yim H. et al., 2011, Nature Chemical Biology, DOI:10.1038/nchembio.580
engineering_actions.rationale: pathway insertion alone is often insufficient without addressing precursor and cofactor (e.g. redox cofactor) requirements from host metabolism.
engineering_actions.expected_effect: improved precursor/cofactor balance supporting higher heterologous pathway throughput
engineering_actions.risk: cofactor-supply engineering can perturb central metabolism and unrelated host pathways
validation: measure relevant cofactor pool ratios before and after host optimization
compare 1,4-BDO titer with and without host-background optimization

_engineering_actions_note: Kept verbatim from DDR schema v1 (not part of the teacher's v2 spec) because workflows/synbio_v1/modules/engineering.py - a separate, older demo pipeline distinct from harness/paper_extraction - still reads this exact key/shape. decision_chain above is the canonical v2 source; this array is a compat projection of the same underlying facts, not independently curated content.

engineering_problem.problem_statement: E. coli cannot naturally produce 1,4-butanediol (1,4-BDO); no native biosynthetic pathway to this product exists in the host.
trigger_conditions: target product has no native biosynthetic pathway in the host organism
engineering objective requires introducing a heterologous or fully synthetic pathway

observations: the host has no endogenous enzymatic route from central metabolism to 1,4-butanediol
introducing enzyme activity alone, without host-level support, may not be sufficient for efficient production
bottlenecks: absence of a native 1,4-BDO biosynthetic pathway
precursor and cofactor availability for a newly introduced heterologous pathway
metabolic burden of expressing a multi-step heterologous pathway
biological_diagnosis.mechanistic_explanation: Because no native pathway to 1,4-BDO exists, production requires constructing a complete heterologous enzymatic route and integrating it with host metabolism; simply inserting the pathway genes is insufficient if the host cannot supply adequate precursor and cofactor flux to support it.

engineering_hypothesis.hypothesis: Combining de novo pathway construction with host-background optimization for precursor and cofactor supply enables functional 1,4-BDO production in a host that lacks the native pathway.
engineering_hypothesis.expected_effect: acquisition of a functional biosynthetic route to 1,4-BDO, with host optimization improving achievable flux beyond pathway insertion alone

extraction_meta.review_notes: 需要专家确认 ldh/adh/pfl/pta/frd 的敲除顺序和论文实际验证的靶标。BDO 是教师 §4.5 规则库中的通量集中规则来源之一。
